basic_info.description: Modern condo adjacent to the vibrant Valencia Corridor, this spacious bi-level condo offers 2+ bedrooms / 3 full bathrooms. The kitchen has stone countertops and stainless steel appliances. The living room and dining room are connected with hardwood floors and a fireplace.  The lower level includes a spacious living area with a bar, full bath, and heated floors on lower level. There is a shared backyard patio with furnishings, solar energy system, in-garage laundry, and 1-car side-by-side parking.
